evaluation.rationale: The notes capture almost all the information from the transcript but fail critically in structure, conciseness, and timeline accuracy. The model generated an excessive number of sections (Overview, Summary, Core concepts, Examples, Formulas, Things to memorize, Confusing points, Questions to review, Study summary, Action items, Decisions, Open questions, Risks, Follow-up draft) and repeated the same facts in almost all of them. Furthermore, it failed to resolve corrections made during the lecture, reporting superseded values (HW4 due date, midterm coverage, who posts the practice exam) as current facts in some sections while listing the corrections in others. There is also a material hallucination regarding the partition scenario, incorrectly stating that leader E commits a write on nodes A, B, and C, which contradicts the premise of the partition. Finally, the Overview and Summary sections contain cut-off sentences.
